firstPlayerRule: Both players cut the deck; the lower card deals the first hand. The non-dealer plays the first card. In later games, the loser of the previous game deals first.
officialTieBreak: If both players cut cards of the same rank, they each draw again.
clarifications: The crib belongs to the dealer.
